title: TNT Dome 2 Key
subtitle: A key trail across Appalachia for TNT Dome 2 at Black Mountain Ordnance Works

sections.title: How to Start
sections.html:
There's no quest to start. The trail begins at Graninger Farm in the Toxic Valley. Bring Rad-X or a Hazmat Suit: the first stop is in an irradiated pond, and so is the dome.

{img:tnt-dome-locations-map}

sections.title: TNT Dome 2 Key Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Go to the pond at Graninger Farm

Fast travel to Graninger Farm in the Toxic Valley and head south-east towards the pond.

{img:dome-2-graninger-farm-pond}

Step 2 – Find the broken safe

A broken house sits in the middle of the pond. The broken safe is inside it. Expect to take some rads.

{img:dome-2-graninger-broken-safe}

Step 3 – Take the Rusted Key

Inside the safe is the Rusted Key, with an Alien Blaster spawn beside it.

{img:dome-2-rusted-key}

Step 4 – Go to Freddy Fear's House of Scares

Fast travel to Freddy Fear's House of Scares in the Mire and clear the enemies first.

{img:dome-2-freddy-fears-house-of-scares}

Step 5 – Climb the stairs to the red door

From the fast travel point face north and walk down the right-hand side of the building to a set of stairs. At the top the red door is on your right.

{img:dome-2-freddy-fears-stairs}

Step 6 – Read the note at the door

A note is half tucked under the red door. Pick it up.

{img:dome-2-red-door-note}{note:BMO_BunkerNote02_HackerNote}

Step 7 – Open the red door with the Rusted Key

The door only opens with the Rusted Key.

{img:dome-2-red-door-rusted-key}

Step 8 – Take the Stolen Terminal Passcode

Inside, the holotape Stolen Terminal Passcode is under the desk. There's also a Mr. Handy model and five fixed board game spawns in this room.

{img:dome-2-stolen-terminal-passcode}

Step 9 – Go to the Shadowbreeze Apartments in Morgantown

Fast travel to Morgantown. From the fast travel point head south-west through the gap the APC made in the wall onto the road: the apartment building is in front of you.

{img:dome-2-shadowbreeze-apartments}

Step 10 – Climb to the balcony

Jump or climb the scaffolding to the second-floor balcony door. Clear the ghouls inside and take the stairs to the top floor.

{img:dome-2-shadowbreeze-scaffolding}

Step 11 – Find Trevor Moorman's terminal

At the top there's a corridor with a doorway at each end. Turn right and go through the door on your left, up the stairs on your left, then right and right again: the terminal is in front of you.

{img:dome-2-trevor-moorman-terminal-room}

Step 12 – Write the access code to the holotape

Read the two messages if you like, then choose Write Access Code to Holotape. With the Stolen Terminal Passcode in your inventory you get the M. Greene Access Code; without it the terminal just says Access Denied. This step can be buggy; if it doesn't work, try another server or a private world.

{img:dome-2-write-access-code-to-holotape}

Step 13 – Go to Pleasant Valley Cabins

Fast travel to Pleasant Valley Cabins in the Savage Divide.

{img:dome-2-pleasant-valley-cabins}

Step 14 – Enter the cabin with the red car

Face west and walk to the first cabin on your right, the one with the red car out front. Clear the turrets inside.

{img:dome-2-cabin-red-car}

Step 15 – Read Trevor's Note

Go to the bedroom at the end. A note sits under the terminal.

{img:dome-2-cabin-terminal-note}{note:BMO_BunkerNote02_CabinNote_01}

Step 16 – Generate the one-time key

Use the terminal (Greene Custom Defense Systems) and choose Generate One-Time Key. It's a random 9-digit code and a new one cancels the old one, so write it down. Without the M. Greene Access Code it refuses you and warns that its security turns hostile.

{img:dome-2-generate-one-time-key}

Step 17 – Drop down from the balcony

Head back towards the kitchen. In the lounge take the door on your left out to the balcony by the yellow chairs, go through the gap in the railing and drop onto the ledge below.

{img:dome-2-cabin-balcony-gap}

Step 18 – Find the safe and keypad

Face south and walk under the house to the rock face. Turn left through the gap in the rocks; at the brick wall turn right. The safe and its keypad are here.

{img:dome-2-cabin-safe-keypad}

Step 19 – Take TNT Dome Key 2

Enter your one-time code on the keypad and open the safe. TNT Dome Key 2 is inside, with some safe loot.

{img:dome-2-key}

sections.title: Finding the Dome
sections.html:
Step 20 – Go to Black Mountain Ordnance Works

Fast travel to Black Mountain Ordnance Works. Follow the road south, turn left at the T-junction and go east until three Blood Eagles stand on your left. Clear them and stand at the dome door they were guarding.

{img:dome-2-black-mountain-dome-2-route}

Step 21 – Find Dome 2

Face south, cross the road to the rock with a tree on your right, jump the rock and walk to the rock face. Turn left: TNT Dome 2 is in front of you. The key opens the door.

{img:dome-2-door}

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
Inside TNT Dome 2 (high rads, so bring protection):

  • {name:recipe_mod_AlienBlaster_AlienMag_AmmoConversion} on the table
  • Alien Blaster rounds: 3 on the table and a metal box under it holding 6 to 42 more
  • 3 Hazmat Suits, Rad-X and RadAway, a random weapon plan, a cash duffle bag, a medkit, a locker and a desk
{img:/wp-content/uploads/guide-images/plan-checklist/weapons/alien-blaster.avif,dome-2-alien-blaster-fusion-mag-plan}

The lab notes on the desk explain what Greene was working on:

{note:BMO_BunkerNote02_BunkerNote}

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I need the code from my last visit?

No. Each Generate One-Time Key makes a new random code and cancels the old one, so just make a new one.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it: the keys, notes and codes are the trail.

What about domes 1, 4, 5 and 6?

Their doors can't be opened. Notes for domes 5 and 6 exist in the game files but aren't placed anywhere, so they look like unfinished content.

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
Black Mountain Ordnance Works is based on a real place, the West Virginia Ordnance Works. The records terminal in its main building (Cole & Parker Holdings LTD) has an entry for each dome; for domes 1, 4, 5 and 6 it only shows DATA READ ERROR.

Dome 2's entry lists Greene Custom Defense Systems on a two-year lease, paid in full. Trevor Moorman's terminal has a message from Mike Greene saying he's moving everything somewhere more secure because someone has taken an interest in their work, and another about a housekeeper who was fired and reported to the authorities.
